newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended Tuesday below New York's previous close on overseas sales, bullion dealers and traders said.
Bullion ended at US$353.00/50 an ounce Tuesday against New York's US$353.30/80 close on Monday.
Morning trade saw two-way business from Japanese traders buying and selling gold on dollar/yen swings, pushing gold to around $352.20/50, dealers said.
Bullion sources also reported follow-through sales from New York in early trading and selling from Australia.
When Europe opened in the afternoon session, gold fell further, but recovered and held at $353 where it found solid support, gold dealers said.
Physical buying was said brisk at these levels.
Local gold ended HK$14 lower at HK$3,264 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -7.00 from its previous fix at -5.50
